title: Checkout 5xx spike after payment refactor release
symptoms: 5xx error rate jumped from under 1% to over 30% within 10 minutes of a deployment; NullPointerException errors in the payment validation code path; unaffected services showed normal latency
root_cause: Null handling bug introduced by the latest release in payment validation
resolution: Rolled back to the previous version; error rate returned to baseline in 6 minutes; fix shipped next day with a regression test

title: Log server disk full from failed log rotation
symptoms: disk usage above 90% and rising steadily; log rotation job failing with no space left on device; write failures in the log pipeline
root_cause: Log rotation job stopped compressing old files so archived logs filled the volume
resolution: Deleted archived logs older than 7 days on the host and usage dropped to 55%; rotation schedule repaired

title: Recommendation service memory leak
symptoms: memory usage climbing steadily for hours with no matching traffic increase; instances killed by out-of-memory; periodic latency spikes before each restart
root_cause: Unbounded in-memory cache growing until the process runs out of memory
resolution: Rolling restart cleared memory; cache size limit added in the next release

title: Stale prices shown after pricing update
symptoms: customers see outdated prices; no errors in logs; cache hit rate normal; no recent deployment of catalog-api but a bulk pricing data import ran
root_cause: Cache kept serving old values because invalidation did not run after a bulk data import
resolution: Flushed the catalog cache and correct prices appeared immediately; invalidation hook added to the import job

title: API gateway saturated during traffic spike
symptoms: CPU above 90% on all instances; request queue growing; latency rising gradually; request volume more than double the normal level; no recent deployment
root_cause: Legitimate traffic surge exceeded provisioned capacity
resolution: Added instances and latency recovered within 10 minutes; autoscaling thresholds lowered

title: Orders failing after database connection pool change
symptoms: connection pool exhausted errors and request timeouts beginning right after a release that changed database settings; error rate rising; database itself healthy
root_cause: Release reduced the connection pool size below what production traffic needs
resolution: Rolled back the release and timeouts stopped within 5 minutes; pool size corrected and load tested before redeploy

title: Checkout timeouts caused by payment provider outage
symptoms: timeouts calling the external payment gateway; elevated 5xx only on payment requests; no recent deployment of our services; provider status page reported an incident
root_cause: Third-party payment provider outage outside our control
resolution: On-call engineer enabled the fallback provider and contacted provider support; a rollback would not have helped
